**Finding submitted: missing (INSURANCE)**

- **Investigation:** The MSA is a single-section short-form agreement (75 paragraphs). A full-text search for "insurance" returned no hits, and reading the whole document confirmed no insurance covenant in the body, and there are no exhibits attached.
- **Direction check:** The rule binds the vendor, not us — Kubient hosts the Auction Platform, receives Requests from AP (p0011), and warrants that it collects, maintains, manages and stores visitor data (p0035). That makes it a hosting/services vendor processing our data, squarely within the rule's scope, and the absence of any coverage sits in walk-away territory.
- **Redline:** Inserted a new General Provisions subsection (j) after p0073 at the preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' comp per law, certificates on request), validated with `ok:true`, with the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) offered in the comment.
